_comment: MIE instrument roles (plan §2.3). Keys are MIDI channels 1-16. `role` is what algorithms target; `group: fantom` shares one voice budget; `note_range` is the final clamp. Phase 0 (2026-09-07) confirmed the hardware: Fantom 8 INT zones on CH2-8, EXT zones CH9-15 -> Nord Grand 2 / Wavestate mk II / Iridium / MODX M6 / Ketron Event 61 / PSR-SX900 / microArranger. CH16 carries Fantom scene bank/program changes and is never a target.

1.name: REAPER VST
1._note_sustain: sustain_ok false (2026-09-09): on the 17:03 take this lane held one note for 24.0 s and two past 8 s, and it was one of the two channels sounding at both PANICs. The flag gates the ceiling in safety.py - sustain_dur_s (30 s) when marked, max_dur_s (8 s) when not.

10.name: Wavestate mk II
10._note_sustain: sustain_ok false on purpose (2026-09-09): the wave-sequencing patches move too much to hold a long note - 「音色多變不適合當延音」. The flag is not just a label: safety.py allows sustain_dur_s (30 s) to an instrument marked for it and max_dur_s (8 s) to one that is not, so this caps anything this synth is asked to hold at 8 s.

13.name: Ketron Event 61
13._note_swell: CC11 on purpose (2026-09-09): the player asked for silence_pad to breathe here. CC11 is CHANNEL-wide, so it sweeps echo_wavestate and sustain_event61 on this channel too - there is no per-note expression in MIDI.
